text:
alex_chang: Customer reported free trial promo not applying, says signup completed but sees "trial held for review". Account id 0x9f3b. Asked for a quick check
support-bot: automated fraud-check: score=87; flags=[disposable_email, vpn_exit_node, new_device, rapid_signups_same_ip]; risk_category=high
maya_patel: Can you paste the IP and email the customer used? Do we have phone on file?
alex_chang: Email is temp-email@dispostable[.]com, IP 185.237.24.11 (geo=NL, ASN shows VPN exit), no phone on file. Customer claims they use VPN for privacy, not fraud.
samir_k: Disposable email + VPN + no phone = typical high-risk pattern. Policy allows manual review if customer provides phone verification or a valid non-disposable email. Otherwise we must hold trial.
maya_patel: Agreed. I'll do a manual review. Running internal check: 
```
> ./admin-tools fraud-inspect --acct 0x9f3b --ip 185.237.24.11
flags: disposable_email, vpn_exit_node, account_age_days=0, same_ip_recent=3
recommendation: hold
```
maya_patel: Next step: ask customer for a phone number for OTP or ask them to sign up without VPN. If they provide OTP we can override and grant trial credits.
alex_chang: Customer replied: can do phone OTP now. Wants immediate access.
maya_patel: OK I'll issue a temporary override after OTP. Once you confirm the OTP, run: 
```
> admin grant_trial --acct 0x9f3b --credit_usd 25 --duration_days 14 --note "manual override after phone OTP"
> admin mark_reviewed --acct 0x9f3b --by maya_patel --outcome approved_phone_verified
```
alex_chang: OTP confirmed (code 482019). Ran the grant command and it returned success. Customer reports trial active and promo applied.
support-bot: action-log: grant_trial acct=0x9f3b actor=maya_patel amt_usd=25 duration=14 note=manual_override_phone; ticket=SUP-8091
maya_patel: Logged the manual review and added a short audit note. Reminded customer: avoid VPN during signup and use a recoverable email to reduce friction. Marking resolved unless you see follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
alex_chang: I'll follow up with customer to confirm usage and close the loop. Thanks team.
samir_k: For records: file a quick policy blurb for the playbook: allow phone-verified overrides, require agent to record OTP confirmation and run admin grant commands. I'll add to the support runbook.
maya_patel: Closing thread.
